app.title: AI API Key Lab
app.tagline: Test, validate, manage and compare your AI API keys. Connect a provider → Add your key → Test a model → Start building.
app.securityNotice: API keys are sensitive credentials. Only add keys you own or are authorized to use. Do not share them publicly.

addons.title: Security & Desktop Add-ons
addons.subtitle: Signed Ed25519 Registry Updates, Opt-In Plain-Text Leak Hunter, and 127.0.0.1 Local OpenAI-Compatible Gateway.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics & Troubleshooting
diagnostics.subtitle: Root-cause breakdown and actionable remediation for failed tests.
diagnostics.browserLimitationNotice: The browser blocked or could not complete the request. This can be CORS or a network problem. It does NOT prove the key is invalid. Test this provider with the desktop app.

history.title: Test History & Analytics
history.subtitle: Audit trail of all test executions (secrets are never recorded).

settings.title: Application Settings
settings.subtitle: Configure appearance, security vault, language, and behavior.
settings.vaultPassphraseHelp: Encrypts stored secrets locally with AES-256-GCM and PBKDF2 (600,000 iterations). Non-extractable key held in memory only.
settings.vaultNoPassword: No Passphrase Set (Secrets stored plaintext in browser storage — Not Encrypted)

backup.title: Backup, Export & Migration
backup.subtitle: Export encrypted backups for macOS desktop or export masked configuration.
backup.createEncryptedDesc: Password-protected backup with PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 (600,000 rounds) + AES-256-GCM authenticated with AAD. Compatible with desktop build.
backup.dangerWarning: Exporting raw unmasked secrets carries security risks. Only export to trusted local environments.
